name: Reel Horror
detailed_description:
Step into the projectionist’s booth and press play if you dare. In Reel Horror, you’re not just watching the film. You’re inside it.

You play as the projectionist of an old, rundown cinema with one job: screen the reels. But each dusty film you thread through the machine doesn't just flicker onto the wall. It pulls you inside. Each reel is its own standalone short horror experience, playable in 10–60 minutes. Some stories are ghostly and surreal. Others are gory, grim, or grotesquely absurd.

The projection room is your hub. From here, you select which cursed film to run next, each unlocking new horrors and secrets. As you explore more reels, you may find that the horror begins to leak back into the real world...

Features

  • A growing anthology of playable horror shorts

  • A mysterious hub world that changes over time

  • Multiple endings and hidden story threads

  • Stylized visuals and varied gameplay with each reel

  • Designed for bite-sized gameplay or full-night marathons

Whether you’re looking for a quick scare or a creeping narrative, Reel Horror invites you to sit back, press play, and survive the show.

short_description: A haunted projectionist’s room. A shelf of cursed films. Each reel plays a terrifying short story you must live through. Explore twisted worlds from the safety of the projection booth, or so you think. How many endings will you find before the film burns out?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2+ Cores, 2+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
